changedAt.description: When the customer was last changed. ISO 8601 date format

changedBy.description: Who last changed the customer. Either web, app or username of employee. Used for traceability in accordance with GDPR

changedByChannel.description: Which sales channel or system who last changed the customer. Used for traceability in accordance with GDPR

countryCode.description: Telephone number country code, starting with +.

createdAt.description: When the customer was created. ISO 8601 date format

createdBy.description: Who created the customer. Either web, app or username of employee. Used for traceability in accordance with GDPR

createdByChannel.description: Which sales channel or system who created the customer. Used for traceability in accordance with GDPR

customerAccountId.description: Customer account id used for account based ticketing

customerAccounts.description: Customer accounts used for account based ticketing

customerConsents.description: The legacy consents connected to the customer.

customerRef.description: Optional customer reference. Defaults to customer number if not set.

ecardOwnerships.description: The ecards connected to the customer.

email.description: Contact email. May become different from username

emailOld.description: When customer is deleted (status='D'), the value of 'email' is moved here to allow creation of a new customer with the same email.

emailVerifiedAt.description: When the email was verified. ISO 8601 date format

expirationDate.description: The date when the customers personal data should be deleted. Personal data will be deleted continuously. ISO 8601 date format

givenConsents.description: The consents connected to the customer. Deprecated

items.description: The consents connected to the customer. Deprecated

languagePreference.description: Deprecated, please use languagePreferenceISO6393. Which language the customer wants information in. Default is 'NO'.

languagePreferenceISO6393.description: Which language the customer wants information in. ISO 639-3 format. Default is 'NOB'.

lastSignInAt.description: When the customer last signed in. ISO 8601 date format

lastSignInFrom.description: Where the customer last signed in from. Typically web or app. Typically used to display to the user where the last login was performed.

nationality.description: The customers nationality. ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format

notes.description: Deprecated. The notes connected to the customer.

organisationId.description: The organisation the customer is registered with.

parentId.description: Id of the parent customer. Used to connect different customer types.

postalAddresses.description: The postal addresses connected to the customer.

preferences.description: The preferences connected to the customer.

profileType.description: Type of profile. Types supported: 'S' = Standard customer, 'P' = Personnel ticket customer, 'T' = Temporary customer. Default is 'S'.

relatedCustomerNumbers.description: The customer number of profiles which has been merged into the current profile. These may be used to lookup customer information in other systems

items.description: The customer number of profiles which has been merged into the current profile. These may be used to lookup customer information in other systems

status.description: Customer status. Statuses supported: 'A' = Active, 'P' = Passive, 'D' = Deleted. Default is 'A'.

telephoneNumber.description: Deprecated. Please use countryCode and telephoneNumberNoCountryCode. Telephone number for customer. This should be a cell phone number.

telephoneNumberNoCountryCode.description: Telephone number without country code or punctuation.

telephoneNumberVerifiedAt.description: When the telephone number was verified. ISO 8601 date format

username.description: Username the customer can use to log unto their profile. Only available on profile type S(tamkunde) and profile status A(ctive)

uuid.description: A universal unique id for the customer. 32 random alphanumeric characters. Not RFC 4122 compliant

vippsId.description: Deprecated. The field is no longer stored. Vipps unique user identifier.

changedAt.description: When the customer account was last changed. ISO 8601 date format

createdAt.description: When the customer account was created. ISO 8601 date format

isDefault.description: True if the account is the default account for the customer

CustomerAccountResponse.description: Customer account connected to a customer

changedAt.description: When the customer consent was last changed.

consentChoice.description: Whether the customer has approved or declined this consent.

createdAt.description: When the customer consent was created.

changedAt.description: When the customer preference was last changed. ISO 8601 date format

createdAt.description: When the customer preference was created. ISO 8601 date format

preferenceValue.description: Value of the preference. This can be things like membership number.

bookingDate.description: When the physical ecard was booked. ISO 8601 date format

changedAt.description: When the ecard was last changed. ISO 8601 date format

createdAt.description: When the ecard was created. ISO 8601 date format

customerId.description: The customer connected to the ecard. Deprecated

ecardNumber16digits.description: The 16 digit ecard number. A combination of ecardNumber, ecardOperator and control digit.

endOfOwnership.description: When the customer removed the ecard connection. ISO 8601 date format

expirationDate.description: When the physical ecard expires. ISO 8601 date format

shippingDate.description: When the physical ecard was shipped to the customer. ISO 8601 date format

startOfOwnership.description: When the ecard was first connected to the customer. ISO 8601 date format

changedAt.description: When the note was last changed. ISO 8601 date format

createdAt.description: When the note was created. ISO 8601 date format

customerId.description: Id of the customer connected to the note.

PersonnelTicketBearer.description: The personnel tickets connected to the customer. Deprecated. Does not contain updated information.

addressLine2.description: Address line 2, often used for c/o information.

changedAt.description: When the postal address was last changed. ISO 8601 date format

countryCode.description: The address country code. ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 format

createdAt.description: When the postal address was created. ISO 8601 date format

customerId.description: The customer connected to the address.

typeOfAddress.description: The type of address. Types supported: 'P' = Private, 'I' = Invoice, 'S' = Shadow.

verifiedAt.description: When the address was verified. ISO 8601 date format

PostalAddressResponse.description: Postal address connected to a customer

changedAt.description: When the preference was last changed. ISO 8601 date format

createdAt.description: When the preference was created. ISO 8601 date format
